notes.title: New extended free demo! Introductory full game offer ends 11 September!
notes.content: [p]I am glad to release a new extended free demo which shows more in-game areas, more game mechanics and demonstrates for the first time the combat with the first 2 shadows (bad selves of NPCS) ! You can try it![/p][p][/p][p]The first update v_1_1 for the full game has been scheduled in a few days, including minor improvements on some game assets and gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: Perception: Heart and Mind is just released!!!
notes.content: [p]Yes, the game is released and for a limited time, will be available for $4.96![/p][p align="start"]This offer is a way of making the game more accessible to everyone. I truly believe that playing [i]Perception: Heart and Mind[/i] can bring both joy and inspiration to players.[/p][p align="start"]Adding the game to your wishlist truly helps support its journey and keeps you updated with all the latest news![/p][p align="start"]Thank you so much for your support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692744/60505b27651051f6bd0c0f9e2676b6eef30cc3b0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Perception: Heart and Mind Demo Release
notes.content: [p]I am very pleased to present my game page on Steam, where you can download its Demo for Windows, Mac and Linux. Steam Deck is supported and the use of a controller is recommended. It won't be long before the full version of the game comes out. English and Greek subtitles are available. I hope you find something different in this game, this was one of my goals while developing it. In case you like the demo, Wishlists and Reviews will be very helpful! [/p]
